annotations.title: Read a document to change it

description: Returns the current contents of a document on HTMLRadar so they can be changed and put back with replace_document. Each image embedded as a data URI appears as a short htmlradar-image reference instead of its data; keep references exactly as they are. A page over 5 MB of text even with its images as references is too large to read whole; with `query`, a word or phrase from the part to change, any page returns only the passages where that text appears, which replace_document `edits` can then change. It reads only this account's documents and changes nothing.

document_id.description: The document to read — the document id from list_documents or list_shares.

query.description: Text to find, 1 to 200 characters, matched literally with letter case ignored, such as a product name or a price. Returns up to 20 passages around the matches, and how many there are, instead of the whole page: the way to edit a page too large to read whole.

name: get_document
title: Read a document to change it
